text.en: Pet owners speak exceptionally highly of Dr. Joe Keane, Dr. Cathal, and the nursing and reception team for their warmth and clinical competence. Clients frequently praise the team for admitting urgent cases quickly when other veterinary practices were closed. Staff are described as reassuring, clear in their guidance, and supportive during emergencies.

Clients credit the veterinary team with successful surgeries and lifesaving treatments, including saving a cat's severely ulcerated eye and stabilizing critically ill kittens. Several owners appreciate that the hospital offered advanced treatment options rather than euthanasia. One reviewer noted post-operative cleanup concerns, but medical outcomes are widely commended.

Pet parents emphasise that both cats and dogs are treated with deep respect and gentleness throughout consultations and overnight hospitalisation. Reviewers note that veterinary nurses take time to comfort frightened pets during emergency admissions. Families feel genuine relief seeing their companions recover and return home in relaxed spirits.

q.en: Does Blackpool Veterinary Hospital offer out-of-hours emergency care?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently report accessing urgent weekend and evening emergency treatment when other local clinics were closed.

q.en: Can the hospital handle complex ophthalmic or surgical cases?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight advanced veterinary care that successfully saved pets from corneal loss and critical illnesses.

q.en: Are emergency consultation fees considered fair?

a.en: Clients report reasonable out-of-hours pricing compared to other emergency providers, although one owner noted an unexpected surgical charge.

q.en: Do staff provide regular updates during overnight pet stays?

a.en: Reviewers note that veterinary staff maintain close contact with owners when pets are admitted overnight for surgery or monitoring.
